title: Aspiring writer-director here. I need advice on something.

commenti.body:
1. Don't sweat the small stuff. If the title isn't good you can change it later.

2. It's fine. I don't really care. It's just a title. There are no movies I like because of the title that I wouldn't like otherwise, or movies I dislike because of the title that I would like otherwise. Right now for November I am watching lots of noir movies. Some of those have very generic titles (*Desperate*, *Obsession*, *Suspicion*) and some even have titles that barely even make sense in the context of the movie (*No Way Out*, *Split Second*). But that doesn't have any influence on how much I enjoy the movies. Often I watch foreign movies and I don't even know their real title until I look them up afterwards, because the title the studio chose for the translation is an entirely different one than a real translation of the original title. But who cares? They're just titles. What matters is the movie.
